How it works

Questions, answered

What is DreamyCats?

A collection of 7,777 cute pixel cats napping on the clouds, on BNB Smart Chain.

How do I mint without connecting a wallet?

Copy the prompt above and paste it to your AI agent. The agent calls the contract directly from your wallet.

How much does it cost?

The first 100 are free, 1 per wallet: you pay only gas. After that, 0.001 BNB each, max 5 per transaction.

Which chain?

BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56).
